svg.text: 图把值放在轴上。布把所有线留在一起，一纬一纬往前。
A chart places values on axes. A cloth holds every thread, and advances one pick at a time.
慢的摊成线，快的糊成噪声。
The slow flatten. The fast blur.
Each keeps its shape. The relation is gone.
各用自己的周期，每个周期同样 24 纬。
交叉的地方，关系才成立。
Each by its own cycle, the same 24 picks.
Where threads cross, a relation is made.
一次交叉不是同一时刻。
同一份数据织两段，两段停在同一个瞬间。
A crossing is not the same moment. Two sections of one cloth, ending together.
